name: Neural cell screening models for endocrine disruption of thyroid hormone signaling
description: Thyroid hormone is crucial for proper brain development. Transmembrane thyroid hormone transport, intracellular deiodination and binding of T3 to the thyroid hormone receptor determine thyroid hormone action in target tissues. Chemical exposure can disrupt these intracellular mechanisms, thereby negatively influencing thyroid hormone homeostasis in the brain. To understand how chemicals affect thyroid hormone homeostasis and brain development, new screening methods are needed. We utilized different human-based in vitro assays to screen endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs)for their capacity to disrupt thyroid hormone homeostasis in brain. Human cell lines representing astrocytes (H4), oligodendrocytes (MO3.13) and neurons (SK-N-AS) were used. Thyroid hormone transport and deiodinase-mediated metabolism were tested using 1 nM radiolabeled thyroid hormone. Thyroid hormone receptor activation was measured using qPCR of the T3-responsive gene KLF9. 12 EDCs were selected for testing, of which 6 were reference compounds used for validation and the other 6 test compounds.

name: Whole-Cell Metabolism Assay
description: Deiodinase activity (D3) in intact MO3.13 and SK-N-AS cells was determined in the whole-cell metabolism assay to characterize endogenous D3 activity. Cells were exposed for 24 hours to CT-medium, 1 nM T3, 2,000,000 cpm/mL [125I]T3 and EDCs. Samples were analysed by UPLC coupled to a RAMONA star; percentage conversion was based on %T1 and %T2 formed (T1 counted double), and data are expressed relative to solvent controls. Reference compounds tested: iopanoic acid, xanthohumol. EDCs tested: silychristin, sulfobromophthalein, chlorpyrifos, tetrabromobisphenol A. File organization: characterisation contains raw/processed data for cell-line characterization; EDCs contains raw/processed data for endocrine disrupting chemicals. Notes: 'Combined metabolism data EDCs' are percentages per experiment; 'metabolism paper calculation' contains calculations for the paper graphs.

name: T3-dependent Gene Expression Assay
description: Gene expression of KLF9 via qPCR in SK-N-AS cells. Relative gene expression was calculated using the 2−ΔΔCt -method. Data were normalized to GAPDH and shown as fold change vs. solvent control.

name: Deiodinase Assay
description: Deiodinase activity (D3) was determined in cell lysate for MO3.13 and SK-N-AS cells. Cell lysates were incubated with 1 nM T3 and 200.000 cpm [125I]T3 for D3, \nand the indicated concentrations of EDCs or vehicle in PED10 for 120 minutes. Samples were analysed on UPLC (Acquity premier, Waters Chromatography B.V., Netherlands) coupled to a RAMONA star (Elisia Raytest, Belgium) detector.\nD3 activity was expressed as fmol/min/mg protein.
